name: terminal
label: A command that types on the word, then 2 to 4 short output lines

variant.label: window = dark terminal, light = paper terminal, bare = no window, the command set big

lines.default: # building 14 pages|+ tests passed|+ uploaded in 9s|! live at example.com
lines.label: Output lines, | separated (2 to 4). Start with '! ' = alert, '+ ' = done, '# ' = dim comment

hot.label: Words in the output to mark

type_dur.label: Typing length in seconds (blank = 0.05 s per character, at most 1.6)

lines_at.label: When each output line rises, | separated

out.label: cut = hold to the end, edge = leave
